scripts.prepare_network

scripts.prepare_network#

PyPSA network construction for the GreenBubble industrial cluster.

This module is the core network builder. It contains:

  • network_dependencies() — resolves implicit technology flag dependencies so that enabling one technology automatically enables its prerequisites (e.g. enabling MEOH also enables H2).

  • build_network() — constructs the full PyPSA network with all active technologies (buses, carriers, generators, links, stores and loads), controlled by the n_flags dict from config.yaml.

The network is built once per run and saved as a NetCDF file ({network}_PRE.nc) before the optimisation step.

Note

In stochastic mode, scripts.create_stoch_scenarios.create_scenarios() couples multiple annual networks into a single LP after this module runs.
